article.headline: O'Keefe scores 20 to give Columbia 75-53 win over Northwestern
article.description: — Gerard O'Keefe tallied 20 points, Josh Pratt added 13, and Columbia defeated Northwestern in a 75-53 rout on Monday night.
article.linkText: O'Keefe scores 20 to give Columbia 75-53 win over Northwestern
article.story: EVANSTON, Ill. -- — Gerard O'Keefe tallied 20 points, Josh Pratt added 13, and Columbia defeated Northwestern in a 75-53 rout on Monday night. The Lions (4-1) have won by double figures in every game of their four-game win streak, and took down Northwestern (3-2) for the first time since an 83-69 victory on Dec. 3, 1969. O'Keefe shot 7 for 12 from the field and made two 3-pointers, and the Lions shot 44% as a team but made just six threes. Columbia was dominant on the glass, outrebounding the Wildcats 43-28. Doug Langford, Mason Ritter, and Connor Igoe each had seven boards. Northwestern took an early lead with a 6-0 run and led for much of the first half. Columbia took the lead for good during a 9-0 run late in the first, and were ahead 28-19 at the break. Angelo Ciaravino had 14 points for the Wildcats on 6-of-12 shooting. Northwestern struggled from the floor, shooting 33%, and made just five of their 24 attempts from deep. Okku Federiko grabbed nine rebounds. Up next Columbia: visits Boston University on Saturday. Northwestern: plays Virginia Tech in the Charleston Classic on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
